title: The frozen lands
description: Another level of difficulty added to Minecraft! Will you survive hunger, monsters, and lack of ressources?
body:
# The frozen lands

This mod doesn't add that much to Minecraft: No new blocks, entities, liquids...

But, it makes the game WAY harder than normal.

You are in an infinite place where everything is frozen.
And... that's it.

I will not take the time to tell you how to progress, because it's up to you to figure it out.


### How to beat the game?

For now, just kill the wither. But the game will update, and the wither is just the beggining...


## **IF YOU ARE STUCK**
